timeline.text: The first passenger train reached the summit of Pikes Peak on the cog railway on June 30.
Father Jean Baptiste Francolon, the architect of Miramont Castle, moved to Manitou Springs for his health.
Historic Manitou Springs, Inc. was formed as a nonprofit.
The Manitou Springs Heritage Museum opened on the first floor of 517 Manitou Avenue.
